subject: Orthosync benchmarking design: prompt bank, dataset format & scoring
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@orthosync.com>, Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@orthosync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed benchmark design for Orthosync

Thanks for the call earlier — great alignment on objectives. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Goal: Run a customer-specific benchmark on representative Orthosync clinical notes to measure accuracy, hallucination, and task-specific extraction fidelity for the triage assistant pilot. We recommend a two-week pilot run on Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) to gather metrics and tune prompts.

High-level recommendations (initial):
- Candidate models: rw-instruct-3b-quant (fast, cost-efficient) and rw-llama2-13b-q4f16 (higher-fidelity for complex prompts). We will run both in parallel and compare token-cost vs. quality.
- Prompt bank: see attached orthosync_prompt_bank_v1.csv (includes ~120 representative prompts across triage, note summarization, and condition extraction).
- Dataset format: CSV with columns: id, prompt, reference_answer, source_type, redaction_flag, created_at. We prefer reference_answer to be canonical text (one row per sample).
- Scoring criteria: use scoring_template_v2.xlsx. Primary metrics: exact match / F1 for entities, human-rated hallucination (0–2), and a weighted quality score (70% accuracy, 20% hallucination, 10% latency/usability).
- Regression concerns: we will pin model versions and run nightly regression checks against a seed prompt set. If quality drops by >3 points on weighted score, automatic rollback to previous variant.

Attachments: orthosync_prompt_bank_v1.csv, scoring_template_v2.xlsx, redwood_benchmark_instructions.pdf (explains how we run the pilot on Dedicated and what logs/artifacts you will see).

Next steps and owners:
1) Orthosync: provide a 250–500 sample de-identified test set in the requested CSV schema (owner: Samira) — target delivery by 2027-07-02.
2) Redwood: spin up Dedicated pilot, upload prompt bank, run 48-72 hour baseline sweep, share initial results (owner: Ben) — target by 2027-07-09.
3) Joint: review initial metrics and agree on threshold for go/no-go (owner: Marissa + Samira) — target review 2027-07-12.

Questions for you now: 1) Are there specific privacy constraints beyond de-identification we should account for? 2) Any internal scoring rubrics Orthosync wants to apply that differ from the template?

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Irene Choi
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@orthosync.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@orthosync.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed benchmark design for Orthosync

Thanks Irene — useful summary. A few clarifications: 

- PII / PHI: we will deliver a de-identified set but need confirmation that Redwood will not persist raw inputs outside the dedicated environment. Can you confirm retention windows and whether we can enforce no-logs?
- Scoring weights: the 70/20/10 split makes sense, but our clinical team would like a second pass where hallucination is weighted at 30% for extraction tasks. Can we run the baseline with your suggested weights and an alternate scoring scenario (70/30/0) for comparison?
- Timeline: July 2 delivery for the dataset is good. We have a procurement check — they asked for a redlined SOW and a procurement contact. I’ve cc’d Procurement and Luca who will shepherd that.

Date: 2027-06-23T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed benchmark design for Orthosync

Samira — short answers and some technical notes: 

1) Retention / no-logs: For Dedicated we can enforce a customer-only data retention policy. By default inputs are kept for 7 days for debugging; if you require no-logs we can enable a no-persist mode for the pilot (we'll annotate this in the SOW). See SOC2 evidence link: https://redwood.ai/docs/private-deployments#soc2-evidence

2) Alternative scoring: absolutely — we'll run both weightings in parallel. In the reporting bundle we will include both the default weighted score and the alternate clinical-weighted score.

3) Dataset format checklist (quick):
- UTF-8 CSV, comma-separated, header row present (id,prompt,reference_answer,source_type,redaction_flag,created_at)
- reference_answer should be plain text, no HTML. For multi-answer tasks include pipe (|) separated tokens and list in metadata column.
- Please include an examples.csv with 10 gold samples for scorer validation.

4) Scoring automation: we'll use scoring_template_v2.xlsx as the authoritative rubric. For the pilot we'll run the Redwood scoring pipeline and deliver a scoreboard CSV + human review notes. I attached scoring_template_v2.xlsx (edited minor clarifications).

5) Infrastructure note: If procurement wants a commercial deployable image, we can include Private (VPC) packaging in the SOW; Marissa, happy to work with you on the redline.

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed benchmark design for Orthosync

All — quick internal update to confirm we are on track. Samira will deliver the de-id CSV by 7/2. Ben will schedule the baseline runs on Dedicated (2 model variants, parallel) and produce the initial scoreboard. Marissa, please prepare a redline SOW and send to Procurement; I’ll add the no-persist flag language and a 7-day default retention with optional no-logs for pilot.

Action items:
- Marissa: draft SOW redline and link DocuSign with preliminary pricing (owner: Marissa) — target 2027-06-30.
- Ben: reserve Dedicated pool and start baseline on receipt of dataset (owner: Ben) — target within 48 hours of dataset delivery.
- Irene: coordinate nightly regression job and alert thresholds (owner: Irene) — target 2027-07-09.

If procurement needs a copy of our SOC2 package up front, point them to: https://redwood.ai/docs/private-deployments#soc2-evidence. Also copying the hubspot deal record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ORTH-2027-043

Thanks — will sync on 7/12 review unless earlier needed.
